neighbours.label: a physical-property modifier in a physics compound ('thermal'/'electrical' conductivity, 'angular' momentum)
fire: Diamond has very high thermal conductivity for a non-metal.
Aluminum is valued for its good electrical conductivity and low weight.
Glass has low thermal conductivity, so it insulates well.
A spinning skater conserves angular momentum as she spins.
Engineers measured the thermal expansion of the steel beam.
Copper wire is chosen for its electrical conductivity in homes.
The thermal resistance of the wall was calculated carefully.
Gold also has excellent electrical conductivity and resists corrosion.
quiet: Diamond is very hard and very rare for a gemstone.
Aluminum is valued for its low weight and low cost.
Glass lets light through, so it is used in windows.
A spinning skater turns faster as she tucks in tightly.
Engineers measured the length of the steel beam.
Copper wire is chosen for its price and flexibility in homes.
The total weight of the wall was calculated carefully.
Gold also has a bright yellow colour and resists corrosion.
